answer: Agents bind to NFC badges tapped at a public point once per epoch. Tap logs are geotagged and open, so one badge can't serve two agents across town. Full weight needs three clean epochs, keeping the lotus of the network from sprouting clones overnight. The points work like a lagoon: every entry shows, and anything trying to wander between two shores at once leaves ripples all the network reads. A thousand fakes cost about $2 in badge hardware plus shipping each, roughly $2,000 all-in, and one double-tap within the epoch slashes the badge's escrow to zero.
